facts.note: At the nine o'clock bell, Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine, and the uncle made a scene of it in front of everyone.
He went up to the library after dinner and stayed there alone.
At 10:18 by his watch he heard a thump on the floor right above, in the atelier, then the repeater: ten slow deep notes he counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones he did not count.
At 10:15 by his watch someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door; at 10:21 someone came quickly down. He did not see who, and the door was shut.
Girard came in at 10:32 by his watch, and they sat together until the temple struck eleven.
